advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Move `_refresh_close_material` above the open-child structural scan (or confirm open-child staleness is intentionally out of scope) so the un-bypassable child-closure gate judges post-sync state.
evidence: transition_close.py:523 `batch = _timed_close_phase(... batch_close_operations, ticket_ids=[ticket_id], tracker_dir=tracker)` runs inside `if target_status == "closed":` at line 522, before line 562 `_refresh_close_material(tracker, force_close)`
_unblock.py:169 `all_states = _loader.reducer.reduce_all_tickets(tracker_dir, ...)` reads the clone's files to compute open_children
transition_close.py:534-542 the open-child refusal states 'the child-closure invariant cannot be bypassed (not even with --force)', so staleness here is more consequential than the AC gate
advisory.finding: The open-child structural scan (`batch_close_operations`, line 523) and `newly_unblocked` detection read tracker ticket state before `_refresh_close_material` runs (line 562), so the un-bypassable open-child gate still judges child-closure status from the pre-sync clone — the same staleness class the change fixes for AC boxes. A child closed in another clone still reads as an open child and refuses the close.
advisory.suggested_fix: Call `_refresh_close_material(tracker, force_close)` at the top of the `if target_status == "closed":` branch (before `batch_close_operations`) rather than only before the completion/AC reduce, or document explicitly that the open-child gate is intentionally judged on local state.
